rows.contract: The graphics API chooser disables unavailable APIs and hides API-specific controls.
rows.native_mapping: Add Metal at its enum ordinal in the Metal build. Test supported-device gating, effective global/per-game API and retain existing external backend controls.
rows.expected_result: The model refuses disabled legacy entries and unsupported native devices and keeps the native API visible for diagnosed selection.
rows.actual_result: Real Qt offscreen UI, no-device discovery, deterministic available/unavailable device variants, global and per-game Spatial, independent guest filtering, native and feature-off compile plus PICA 48/801 and CTest 64 passes.

rows.contract: Device chooser displays source devices by saved ordinal, preserving count and ordering.
rows.native_mapping: Use the shared native bridge to set actual per-device availability and Spatial flags, preserving indices and global rows.
rows.expected_result: Synthetic fixture verifies supported/unsupported, multiple devices and native converted names. API-specific rows are only visible for the applicable backend.
rows.actual_result: Real Qt offscreen UI, no-device discovery, deterministic available/unavailable device variants, global and per-game Spatial, independent guest filtering, native and feature-off compile plus PICA 48/801 and CTest 64 passes.

rows.contract: Graphics setting application preserves global-versus-per-game override semantics and live startup constraints.
rows.native_mapping: Reuse ConfigurationShared per-game trackers and unchanged settings for synchronized/async compilation and presentation, cache/filtering, vsync, timing and accuracy. Preserve device index when native discovery gives none.
rows.expected_result: Global and per-game apply select correct native option and keep separate overridden/filter/timing settings.
rows.actual_result: Real Qt offscreen UI, no-device discovery, deterministic available/unavailable device variants, global and per-game Spatial, independent guest filtering, native and feature-off compile plus PICA 48/801 and CTest 64 passes.

rows.contract: Vulkan-only SPIR-V options should never configure Metal direct MSL.
rows.native_mapping: Disable excluded backend entries and hide SPIR-V widgets from the native path; bind MetalFX Spatial only for Metal.
rows.expected_result: Inspect real widget state for both device-less and capability-selecting deterministic runs.
rows.actual_result: Real Qt offscreen UI, no-device discovery, deterministic available/unavailable device variants, global and per-game Spatial, independent guest filtering, native and feature-off compile plus PICA 48/801 and CTest 64 passes.

rows.contract: An enabled preference can be turned off after a switch to a device without native Spatial.
rows.native_mapping: Define the Phase 088 update method and shared check state, allow enabled preference opt-out as a state transition and prevent re-enabling with unsupported hardware.
rows.expected_result: Qt fixture reproduces then passes supported to unsupported to opt-out and supported again, with global/per-game independence and no filter changes.
rows.actual_result: Reproduced Qt assertion before fix. Native/off compile, link, exact unsupported-device opt-out fixture, PICA and CTest retested.

rows.contract: The generated Designer form owns one Metal entry and one Spatial checkbox with stable Qt API ordinals.
rows.native_mapping: Consume generated fields directly and keep disabled builds free of the Metal API choice. Reapply translated names at the model’s per-game offset.
rows.expected_result: Actual duplicate-control failure then success for UIC field identity, per-game retranslation and opt-out.
rows.actual_result: Reproduced duplicate UI identity with new UIC. Native/off compile, actual Qt linkage, Designer, per-game and independent settings tests passed.
